note: A hand-written single-vector probe of the SASL frame layer's own rules, kept as an instrument rather than as corpus: the octets are spelled out so nothing here depends on the generator, the step builder or the vector vocabulary. It is the reading of «The frame body of a SASL frame MUST contain exactly one AMQP type, whose type encoding MUST have provides="sasl-frame". Receipt of an empty frame is an irrecoverable error.» — the one sentence in which an empty frame is not the traffic the idle-timeout clause licenses but a wire-level failure. Run it with either binary: the third step must be refused with amqp:connection:framing-error and class malformed, leaving the peer at END, and a layer that short-circuits on a bodyless frame before the layer is consulted admits it instead and fails here.

steps.note: the frame announces SIZE 8 with DOFF 2 and no body at all: a well-formed empty frame, which is what the AMQP layer admits as idle-time-out traffic and what this layer must not

note: The same rule after the dialogue has begun, and the channel octets of a SASL frame ignored in the same vector: the third step's channel field is 0x1234 and the frame is admitted because «Bytes 6 and 7 of the header are ignored», which is the second sentence of the SASL Frames clause. The fourth step is the empty frame again, at a moment where the layer is in the dialogue rather than waiting for it, so a layer that refused the empty frame only at its first moment fails here.

steps.note: the mechanisms announcement, on channel 0x1234: the octets carry no meaning here and the frame is the same frame

note: «The maximum size of a SASL frame is defined by MIN-MAX-FRAME-SIZE. There is no mechanism within the SASL negotiation to negotiate a different size.» The third step is a sasl-init whose initial response is 616 octets, in a 648-octet frame — 136 octets past the 512 the artifact names — so it is refused under that bound before the dialogue's own moment is consulted. A body large enough to exceed the bound needs the 32-bit list encoding, which is why this step is the long one.

«A SASL frame has a type code of 0x01» is a rule about the frame's type octet, and this is it from the other side: the third step is the mechanisms announcement carried in a type-0x00 frame, which the frame layer refuses because a performative whose encoding declares provides="sasl-frame" cannot travel in a frame whose role is the AMQP one. The step is in the AMQP layer, so it is the frame layer that answers and not the SASL dialogue's layer rule.

steps.note: type octet 0x00, so an AMQP frame, carrying a performative that provides only sasl-frame
